# Healthy Minds NYC

> A therapy and mental health practice in NYC offering individual therapy, psychiatry, couples counseling, life coaching, and psychological assessments for professionals and individuals.

Healthy Minds NYC specializes in evidence-based mental health services including CBT, Gottman Method couples therapy, medication management, and life coaching. The practice serves the NYC area with a team of licensed therapists, psychiatrists, and coaches focused on treating anxiety, depression, ADHD, relationship issues, and personal growth.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Couples Therapy
- Individual Therapy
- Medication Management
- Anxiety & Depression
- Life Coaching
- Gottman Method
- Relationship Counseling
- Psychological Testing
- ADHD Assessment
- Premarital Counseling
- Trauma-Focused Therapy
- Midtown Manhattan
- Licensed Therapists
- Mental Health Services

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://www.healthyminds.nyc): Healthy Minds NYC homepage for therapy services in New York.
- [Free Consultation](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/freeconsultation): Getting started guide with free consultation and therapy matching process.
- [About Our Practice](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/about): About Healthy Minds NYC practice philosophy and team leadership.

## Therapy & Psychiatry Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services): Overview of therapy, psychiatry, coaching, and mental health services.
- [Therapy & Psychiatry](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/therapy-psychiatry): Therapy and psychiatry services including individual and couples care.
- [Individual Therapy](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/therapy-psychiatry/individual-therapy): Individual therapy for anxiety, depression, burnout using CBT and evidence-based treatment.
- [Couples Therapy](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/therapy-psychiatry/couples-therapy): Couples therapy using Gottman Method and Emotionally Focused Therapy.
- [Medication Management](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/therapy-psychiatry/medication-management): Psychiatric medication management for anxiety, depression, ADHD, and mental health conditions.
- [Psychological Testing & Assessments](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/therapy-psychiatry/psychological-testing): ADHD and mental health assessments with diagnostic clarification and next steps.

## Coaching & Relationship Growth

- [Coaching & Relationship Growth](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/coaching-relationship-growth): Life coaching and relationship growth services for personal development.
- [Life Coaching](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/coaching-relationship-growth/life-coaching): Life coaching for goal-setting, career transitions, and work-life balance.
- [Premarital Counseling](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/coaching-relationship-growth/premarital-counseling): Premarital counseling using Prepare/Enrich for marriage preparation.
- [Relationship Enrichment](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/services/coaching-relationship-growth/relationship-enrichment): Relationship enrichment with Gottman Checkup and Bringing Baby Home programs.

## Our Team

- [All Providers](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/providers): Directory of Healthy Minds NYC licensed therapists and specialists.
- [Wini Idu-Scott](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/provider/wini-idu-scott): MFT Associate Therapist specializing in couples and trauma therapy.
- [Diane Grogan](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/provider/diane-grogan-mft): MFT Associate trained in Gottman Method couples therapy.
- [Gabriella Forte](https://www.healthyminds.nyc/provider/gabriella-forte-lmsw): LMSW specializing in CBT and trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy.
